description: At session start, adds two lines naming the active plan and the next step; before a compaction, tells the summary what a build in progress needs kept; at each stop, records the session's transcript and refreshes the HUD state in the background. Loads the HUD mod: a band above the prompt and a pane showing plan progress, answered by /dflow:hud, which also compacts the context at a task boundary when dflow asks for a reset.
